notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes:
Just uploaded a small patch to make the following changes:

Added on screen objective markers

Made health pickups give full health

Fixed issue with AI getting lazy and just standing there.

notes.title: Leaderboard Reset
notes.notes:
Just letting you all know I've reset the leader board due to a totally new score setup.

It's a bit more forgiving this time around no more negative scores!

Have fun,

Mike.

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER UPDATE NOW LIVE!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

After a LOT of work, and testing, the multiplayer update is now live!

Enjoy playing with a friend, and have fun in the new map and new destroy the cache game mode!

It's not over yet, a lot more planned for this year so stay tuned!![img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33208220/dffe4a9a8a08475028db29771b4c9786902f29e2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Looking Good For Update Release
notes.notes:
All going well, the game update will be live at the end of next week, around the 22 February.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33208220/1b4797bcdb03591544c4b3ab015aa88fd389ef23.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Bugs have been Squashed!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

After a lot of testing and re-writing, I'm satisfied all of the bugs i can find have been dealt with.

There are a few finishing touches left to do, and the big multiplayer update will be ready to release. 

This has been a huge task and i had to totally re-write the game, but i'm sure it was worth it!!

Thanks for your patience,

Mike.[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33208220/1d39c3f020eda8242a25cebd1b73d68e5b3c461c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Still Working on It
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

i had hoped to get the Multiplayer update out before the new year, but there has been some stubborn bugs i'm still working on, and finding testers to help over the holiday season has been rather difficult.

I'm still working on getting the new update out asap. 

Thanks,
Mike.

notes.title: Almost There!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

The update is almost ready! New map is finished, as is the armory and character selection.

just working out a few multiplayer kinks, and the new build will be uploaded as soon as we can!

notes.title: Almost Ready!
notes.notes:
Multiplayer update is almost good to go! 

Game play is working, just finishing off the new menu design as well as the armory.

have added two new Enemies, and it should have a new map in the next update.

Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: Multiplayer is Coming!
notes.notes:
Hey all,

I''m close to finishing a big update, which includes the following:

2 player co-op
Character selection
An armory, where you can use money earned to buy better kit for the next run

I've also gotten rid of the harsh points penalty for dying and failing to disarm the bomb.

Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: New Character!
notes.notes: Hi all, I've changed the Player character to something that looks a bit better i feel. See what you think!
